name: Yamasumi
source:
A seasoned resistance leader known for his wine-making skills and farming expertise, Yamasumi leads another Halve resistance group whose base located under District 3.

Despite his scars and battle-hardened exterior, he is a caring father figure to the resistance members and a loving partner to Shioba.

Likes: His family, wine-making and farming, playing mahjong

Dislikes: Bad luck, being called old, his son's recklessness

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/yamasumi]official description[/url]]
